title: photosynthesis
description:
- eleases oxygen that humans and animals breathe.
- It supports food chains and ecosystems.
- It helps remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.
Example: A sunflower uses sunlight, water from the soil, and carbon dioxide from the air to make the food it needs to grow.
Remember this for exams
Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants use sunlight and chlorophyll to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose, releasing oxygen as a by-product.
